cohort: All live births in Brazil between January 1st, 2014, and December 31st, 2016
finding: The overall cesarean section rate in Brazil was 56%, with significant variation observed across different Robson Group Classifications and regions of Brazil.
mod_finding: Vaginal births were more frequent in Robson Groups 1, 3, and 4, while cesarean section rates were highest in groups 5, 6, 7, and 9.
